description: There is a reason why motorists entering North Carolina are greeted with a sign that welcomes them to the “Nation’s Most Military Friendly State.” It is because we have led the way when it comes to supporting our military families and the installations they serve on.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ELECT JOHN BELL COMMITTTEE
title: BELL: General Assembly Works to Ensure NC is ‘Most Military Friendly State’
